full_judgment: 3. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted Other Class Suit No.128 of 2001 in the Court of the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Netrokona praying for a decree of permanent injunction against the defendants. The plaintiffs' case in short, is that the suit land measuring 0.30 acre appertaining to CS Khatian No.46, SA Khatian No.40, SA Plot No.27, Mouza-Gondorpur, Police Station and District- Netrokona belonged to Md Dulal Mia and Abul Hossain. The plaintiff vide registered kabala No.131 dated 25-4-1989 purchased 0.20 acre of land from Md Dulal Mia and Abul Hossain by registered kabala No.648 dated 18-1-2001 and also purchased 0.10 acre of land from Abut Hossain vide registered kabala No.648 dated 18-1-2001. Accordingly, delivery of possession was made and the plaintiff has been possessing the same by making homestead, pond and planting trees. Earlier in a suit for partition bearing No.203 of 1990, the plaintiff and his vendor got a sole decree regarding 0.47 acre of land including the suit land. The defendants have no title and possession in the suit land but on 14-7-2001, the defendants forcibly tried to take over possession of the suit property. Accordingly, the plaintiff filed the instant suit.
